## What changes?

Describe the problem and what server owners will notice after this change. Link the related issue, if there is one.

## How was it checked?

List the relevant tests or server checks. For changes to temporary world edits, saved progress or map updates, include restart and cleanup behavior.

## Anything a reviewer should know?

Note compatibility changes, new settings, performance costs or remaining limitations.

- [ ] Documentation matches the change where needed.
- [ ] No worlds, server files, logs or profiler captures are included.
